notes.title: Patch notes for the Button Button 0.5.2 Beta
notes.notes:
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/359a3dcc6017dfe29a259ddb63a2dfe15a8ebc47.png
Hey! Guys!~_(:3 」∠)_
Button Button local battle mode DEMO is now available.
  ● It just a tentative and simple programme.
  ● Not supported the Online mode for the time being.ಥ_ಥ）
  ● Just support 2P/3P/4P battle.
  ● With the controller  identifying P3/P4 first.
  ● human's best friend, AI, is still on the way.

Fight for Light mode test:
This is a temporary programme that currently supports only Local 2/3/4 battles, with the controller  identifying P3/P4 first.
Rule: a score is scored by taking the Light Pad alone, the first 1000 points, or the top points after the time up as the winner！
